# gitea_team_members (Data Source)

Lists members of a Gitea team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_team_members" "example" {
  team_id = 1
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) The ID of the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `members` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `username` (String)
